experiment.title: Exact FNSPID negative-pressure HAR transfer to LSEG
experiment.objective: Apply the unchanged FNSPID aggregate negative-pressure hysteresis rule to the frozen LSEG HAR base and test whether its timing improves return or downside relative to HAR and an exposure-matched constant.

backward_finbert_firm_open.role: strictly prior negative-pressure warm-up; sessions before 2025-10-27

inputs.source_regime: Reuters LSEG only; no FNSPID observations are pooled

sentiment_rule.daily_pressure: headline-count-weighted negative-story share across complete 33-company sessions
sentiment_rule.incomplete_backward_sessions: missing pressure observations; never filled and never treated as neutral
sentiment_rule.normalisation: current pressure minus strictly prior rolling mean, divided by strictly prior rolling standard deviation
sentiment_rule.missing_z: retain previous state; before the first valid z-score remain risk-on

portfolio.base: Notebook 46 frozen HAR exposure transferred from FNSPID development
portfolio.composition: base HAR exposure multiplied by 1.0 or 0.25
portfolio.matched_control: constant multiplier chosen only to equal the overlay's mean exposure

primary_family: overlay minus HAR mean net return
inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the two two-sided primary tests at q=0.05
inference.matched_exposure_attribution: overlay minus constant-multiplier net return and downside reduction
inference.timing_placebo: all circular placements of the unchanged binary multiplier; one-sided exact return and downside p-values corrected as a two-test family

gates.return_gate: return interval lower bound above zero, BH q below 0.05, Sharpe improvement at least 0.10, and non-negative overlay-minus-HAR mean in both halves
gates.useful_risk_gate: downside interval lower bound above zero, BH q below 0.05, relative drawdown improvement at least 10 percent, return interval lower bound no worse than -1 bp per session, and non-negative overlay Sharpe in both halves
gates.timing_gate: observed downside reduction exceeds the mean shifted reduction and its one-sided BH q is below 0.05
gates.cross_source_support: at least the useful-risk gate and timing gate must pass; otherwise the FNSPID risk-timing mechanism does not transfer on this LSEG window

claim_boundaries: The 167-session LSEG outcome window was already opened before this specification.
The earlier LSEG news block is used only to construct strictly prior pressure history; its company returns are not pooled into this index-level test.
No scorer, threshold, state rule, rolling window, exposure multiplier, cost, or comparison may change after this freeze.
A failed transfer is a portability limit, not permission to reverse or tune the rule.
The separate materiality 2026 confirmation remains sealed.
